summary: Axonex AI Group Ltd, a BVI-incorporated foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a board-approved two-for-five reverse stock split across its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective at the October 22, 2026 market open under symbol AXNX (new CUSIP G6146G125). Class A shares fall from 15,190,742 to roughly 6,076,297; fractional shares round up and options/warrants adjust by 2.5. The action targets regained compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid rule; no shareholder vote was required. Watch for post-split price support and any bid-price cure period.
